title: Static Spherically Symmetric Chaplygin and Polytropic Fluid Solutions in Teleparallel $F(T)$ Gravity
summary: We investigate static, spherically symmetric (SS) spacetimes in covariant teleparallel $F(T)$ gravity sourced by nonlinear Chaplygin and polytropic fluids. Using the covariant coframe/spin-connection (CSC) formalism, we derive the corresponding field equations and conservation laws governing admissible matter distributions and nonlinear torsion sectors. A general reconstruction procedure is developed, allowing the systematic determination of teleparallel $F(T)$ models for arbitrary coframe ansätze and fluid equations of state.
